qualifier: phosphatidylglycerol and phosphatidylcholine via CDP intermediates
name: Phosphatidylglycerol and phosphatidylcholine synthesis via CDP intermediates
rationale: All members are CDP-DAG/CDP-choline routes to PG and PC (including PG remodeling), unlike confusables centred on PA/DAG/TAG synthesis or cardiolipin.

name: Centrosome and spindle positioning in neural progenitor division
rationale: Members cover centrosome/spindle localization and asymmetric division together with forebrain neuroblast/progenitor division and neural stem cell maintenance, which the centriole/microtubule-nucleation confusables lack.

qualifier: transcription elongation, termination and pre-rRNA spacer cleavage
name: rRNA transcription elongation, termination and spacer cleavage
rationale: Members are Pol I (and 5S Pol III) rRNA elongation/termination plus ETS/ITS endonucleolytic pre-rRNA cleavage, distinct from confusables on Pol I initiation/chromatin regulation, MYC-driven biogenesis or Pol III termination.

name: Purine salvage and PRPP synthesis
rationale: All members concern APRT/HPRT1 purine base and nucleoside salvage and supply of its PRPP co-substrate, whereas confusables cover purine catabolism or de novo synthesis.

name: Neuropeptide GPCR signaling in sleep, stress and social behavior
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/opioid/orexin/relaxin GPCR signaling with sleep-wake, stress, mating, parental and aggressive behaviors, beyond confusables focused on feeding, psychostimulant responses or HPA hormone secretion.

qualifier: lead, mercury, cobalt with HMOX1 oxidative defense
name: Lead, mercury and cobalt response with HMOX1 oxidative defense
rationale: Members are responses to lead, mercury, cobalt, selenium and iron(II) plus HMOX1 and peroxide control, distinguishing them from zinc/copper/cadmium metallothionein confusables and the iron-homeostasis confusable.

name: UDP-sugar transport and UDP-glucuronate formation
rationale: Members cover formation of UDP-glucuronate and transport of UDP-sugars into secretory organelles, unlike confusables on UDP-GlcNAc synthesis, PAPS, SLC35 disease variants or N-glycan processing.

name: Scavenger receptor clearance and iron-heme uptake
rationale: Members combine transferrin/heme/iron import and iron-transport disorders with class A/B/F/H scavenger receptor clearance and immune complex clearance, which all confusables lack.

name: Neural plate, border and hindbrain anteroposterior patterning
rationale: Members cover anterior/posterior neural plate, plate border and neural crest specification plus HOX-driven rhombomere and midbrain-hindbrain boundary development, unlike dorsoventral/axial mesoderm confusables.

qualifier: Fas regulation in T cells and hepatocytes
name: Death receptor apoptosis regulation in T cells and hepatocytes
rationale: Members concern Fas/TRAIL/TNF death-receptor apoptosis and its regulation in activated T cells, thymocytes and hepatocytes, whereas confusables emphasize caspase-8/c-FLIP control and necroptosis.

name: TGF-beta-SMAD signaling with cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta receptor/SMAD signaling and its downregulation, cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMADs, TGFBR3 and RUNX3 targets, unlike activin, Hippo/YAP or mutant-free confusables.

qualifier: FGFR2 cascades and activating FGFR1/2/4 point mutants
name: FGFR2 downstream cascades and activating FGFR1/2/4 point mutants
rationale: Members are FRS/SHC/PLC cascades of FGFR2 and constitutively active FGFR1/2/4 mutants, whereas confusables cover FGFR3 or FGFR1 cascades and ligand binding.

name: Cellular senescence with heterochromatin foci and Polycomb silencing
rationale: Members span replicative, oncogene- and stress-induced senescence, SASP, SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin and BMI1 Polycomb modules, unlike confusables framed by p53/oxidative stress and G0 exit.

name: MHC class I cross-presentation of exogenous antigens
rationale: All members are endosomal/phagosomal routes delivering exogenous antigen to MHC class I, distinct from endogenous class I loading/proteasome and MHC class II confusables.

core: Immunoregulatory receptor control of lymphocyte activation
name: Immunoregulatory receptor control of T, NK and dendritic cells
rationale: Members involve lymphoid-APC immunoregulatory interactions and costimulation regulating T cell, NK cell and dendritic cell activation, including NK inhibition absent from tolerance/Treg and DC-signature confusables.

name: BDNF-TrkB neurotrophin signaling
rationale: All members are BDNF/NTRK2 signaling including CDK5 and RAC1 branches and synaptic modulation, unlike NGF-ERK5/CREB or postsynaptic cytoskeleton/receptor-trafficking confusables.

core: Endocrine steroid and vitamin D hormone synthesis
name: Steroidogenesis, vitamin D and phosphate-mineral homeostasis
rationale: Members combine adrenal/gonadal steroidogenesis and its defects, vitamin D activation, Na/Pi transport, FGF23-Klotho/PTH signaling and tooth/bone mineralization, unlike retinoid/vitamin K, thyroid or mineralization-only confusables.

name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: All members are estrogen or progesterone receptor responses, distinct from androgen, mammary development and thyroid receptor confusables.

name: Cap-dependent translation initiation and peptide elongation
rationale: Members cover eIF3/43S formation, scanning, 60S joining and elongation, whereas confusables cover ribosome biogenesis, termination and mRNA surveillance.

name: Neurexin-neuroligin excitatory postsynapse assembly and EPSP regulation
rationale: Members are neurexin/neuroligin-driven PSD-95 and NMDA receptor clustering with excitatory postsynaptic potential control, unlike presynaptic adhesion or inhibitory-synapse confusables.

name: Type 2 immunity via Th2 cytokines and eosinophils
rationale: Members cover IL-4/IL-5/IL-13/IL-33 signaling, Th2 differentiation, eosinophil and mast cell development and IgE switching against nematodes, unlike broad cytokine or FcεRI degranulation confusables.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage with LXR and lipophagy control
rationale: Members regulate triglyceride storage, lipid droplet disassembly and lipophagy, with LXR (NR1H2/3) lipogenic/lipolytic programs absent from glycerolipid-synthesis and lipase confusables.

name: PD-L1 turnover and HIV Nef/Vpu immune receptor downregulation
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin/ERAD-mediated removal of PD-L1, CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC I that tunes T cell responses, unlike antigen-presentation and proteasome-assembly confusables.

name: PDGF receptor signaling regulation
rationale: All three members regulate PDGF receptor (beta) signaling, while confusables are downstream ERK/PI3K or fibroblast stromal programs.

name: Locomotor and reflex behavior with cerebellar Purkinje development
rationale: Members are locomotor, walking, swimming, grooming and righting behaviors plus Purkinje layer and amygdala development, unlike confusables on proprioception, synaptic transmission or sensory/vocal behavior.
